calculationBasis: Per-serving ingredient-sum estimate: sum(GI × Fineli Rel20 available carbohydrate per serving)/100. Published exact values, explicit analogues, and category means may be used with source, match kind, and confidence disclosed. Ingredients below 1 g available carbohydrate per serving are omitted. Not a measured mixed-meal response.
fineliEvidence: docs/nutrition/fineli-release-20-reference.json; only required records are copied into docs/nutrition/food-records.json. Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL), Fineli Rel20, CC BY 4.0.
massEvidence: Amounts are from structured Finnish recipe frontmatter. Grams use listed weights; other units use food-specific Fineli Rel20 MASS values. If only dl mass exists, rkl/tl are converted from food-specific density using 15/5 ml spoon volume and documented per ingredient.
excludedIngredientPolicy: Trace seasonings and unspecified salt are conservative documented assumptions, omitted only below 1 g available carbohydrate per serving. Unresolved substantial ingredients block totals.

selectionNotes.selectionBasis: New recipes were selected from the highest current recipe-level available-carbohydrate estimates outside the first cohort; every selected recipe is recalculated from its ingredient-level Fineli amounts.
replacements: Massaman chicken curry was replaced with eggplant and minced-beef casserole because Fineli Rel20 had no matching Massaman curry-paste record and the unbranded paste has material carbohydrate.
Beef liver casserole was replaced with VHH cabbage casserole because no preparation-relevant published GI value for liver was found for a carbohydrate contribution above the omission threshold.
